title: Blob Analysis
text: Statistics for labeled regions, 1 input, 3 outputs, {Statistics output data type} sets Output data type; {Area} sets the number of pixels in labeled, {Centroid}, {BBox} sets the bounding box coordinates M, {Major axis length} sets the length of major axis of ellipses, {Minor axis length} sets the length of minor axis of ellipses, {Orientation}, {Eccentricity}, {Equivalent diameter squared}, {Extent}, {Perimeter}, {Connectivity} sets the number of labeled regions, {Output label matrix}, {Maximum number of blobs}, {Warn if maximum number of blobs is exceeded}, {Output actual number of blobs} sets the number of blobs, {Specify minimum blob area in pixels} sets the minimum blob area in pixels, {Specify maximum blob area in pixels} sets the maximum blob area in pixels intmax, {Exclude blobs touching image border}, {Output blob statistics as a variable size signal}, {Fill empty spaces in output} and {Fill values} sets the scalar used to fill empty spaces in output. Values come from the instance.
